incentives.name: Data Center Sales Tax Exemption
incentives.what: New data centers (NAICS 518210/519130) investing $25M+ and creating 10+ jobs at 150% of county avg wage within 36 months get 100% state and local sales/use tax exemption on utilities, machinery, equipment, computers and construction materials for up to 15 years; expanding facilities ($5M+, 5 jobs) up to 10 years. Capped at DED's projected 10-year net fiscal benefit. DED approves in advance.

incentives.name: Chapter 100 / Port KC revenue bonds and property tax abatement (local)
incentives.what: Local bodies issue revenue bonds and grant property tax abatements for data centers, e.g. Port KC for Project Mica (25-yr 75% abatement) and Independence for Nebius (98%/90% abatement, 20 yrs).

dockets.id: Ameren Missouri large load tariff (case number not on PSC page)
dockets.what: Large load tariff under SB 4 (2025): 12-year minimum contract plus optional 5-year ramp, collateral of two years of minimum bills, exit and early termination fees, minimum bill with 80% demand charge, cost stabilization recovery.

dockets.id: Evergy large load tariff (case number not on PSC page)
dockets.what: Large load tariff under SB 4 (2025), same core terms as Ameren's.
Large load tariff case under SB 4 (2025).

laws_and_bills.name: SB 4 (2025)
laws_and_bills.what: Requires the PSC to set large load customer (incl. data center) rates so those customers pay their share of costs and others are not charged unjust costs.

local_rules.what: About one-year moratorium on data center projects after Project Cumulus was pulled; council set to vote on a permanent citywide ban in May 2026.
local_rules.status: moratorium in effect; permanent ban vote outcome not confirmed

local_rules.what: County lifted its own six-month pause on data centers.

Planning and Zoning Commission approved a data center ordinance focused on standby generators (setbacks 25 ft from industrial, 50 ft commercial, 100 ft residential); sent to the Board of Aldermen Dec 16, 2025.
Six-month moratorium covering the proposed Scaled Microgrids data center outside Maryville.
Citizen petition for a 12-month data center moratorium (Joplin Sustainable Technology Alliance) fell short: 2,832 of 5,032 signatures.
